description: Taint rules from Heroes of Horror. Depravity measures mental and spiritual corruption; Corruption measures physical corruption. Both are tracked on a 0–9 scale. Effects are cumulative — a character with depravity 5 also has all effects from scores 1–4.

depravityEffects.label: Touched
depravityEffects.effect: Occasional nightmares. -1 penalty on Will saving throws against fear effects.

depravityEffects.label: Troubled
depravityEffects.effect: Frequent nightmares. -1 morale penalty on attack rolls and saving throws when not in combat.

depravityEffects.label: Haunted
depravityEffects.effect: Suffers from mild delusions. -2 penalty on Charisma-based skill checks due to erratic behavior.

depravityEffects.label: Corrupted
depravityEffects.effect: Vivid hallucinations and obsessive thoughts. -2 penalty on all Wisdom checks and Wisdom-based skill checks.

depravityEffects.label: Tainted
depravityEffects.effect: Impulse control is compromised. Once per day, must succeed on a DC 14 Will save or take an action compelled by darker urges.

depravityEffects.label: Debased
depravityEffects.effect: Alignment shifts one step toward evil. -2 penalty on Charisma checks with good-aligned creatures.

depravityEffects.label: Defiled
depravityEffects.effect: Cannot benefit from morale bonuses. Must make DC 16 Will save each day or become consumed by a dark compulsion for 1d4 hours.

depravityEffects.label: Forsaken
depravityEffects.effect: Alignment is evil. Other characters can sense the wrongness; -4 penalty on Charisma checks with non-evil creatures.

depravityEffects.label: Lost
depravityEffects.effect: Completely consumed by taint. Character becomes an NPC villain under the DM's control.

corruptionEffects.label: Marked
corruptionEffects.effect: Minor cosmetic change (e.g., an eye changes color, a patch of skin discolors). No mechanical effect.

corruptionEffects.label: Blemished
corruptionEffects.effect: Skin begins to look unhealthy or wrong. -1 penalty on Charisma checks in formal social situations.

corruptionEffects.label: Afflicted
corruptionEffects.effect: One of the senses begins to fail or distort (e.g., taste disappears, eye becomes milky). -2 penalty on related skill checks.

corruptionEffects.label: Marred
corruptionEffects.effect: More pronounced physical changes visible to others. -1 penalty to Charisma score (permanent until taint is reduced).

corruptionEffects.label: Corrupted
corruptionEffects.effect: Body warps noticeably (e.g., blackened veins, rotting flesh patches). -2 penalty on Charisma-based skill checks.

corruptionEffects.label: Mutated
corruptionEffects.effect: Body develops unnatural mutations. Gain one minor mutation (DM's choice) but suffer -2 penalty to one physical ability score.

corruptionEffects.label: Warped
corruptionEffects.effect: Physical form is grotesque. -4 penalty on Charisma checks; strangers may react with fear or hostility.

corruptionEffects.label: Ruined
corruptionEffects.effect: Multiple severe mutations. -2 to all physical ability scores and -4 Charisma.

corruptionEffects.label: Destroyed
corruptionEffects.effect: Body fails entirely; character dies unless sustained by dark magic. If kept alive, is a monstrous shell of their former self.
